GR22 a) expressly permits them to differ, so five equal numbers is a determination and not a tautology. b) universal - the bare form binds to CobolObject? and accepts any reference (the drift theory's bare-receiver leg, SS14.9.39.3 SR8). c) interface-name-1 - `01 R ... PB451I.` holds a PB451D object and dispatches through the interface. d)1.a. - `FACTORY OF PB451B` holds PB451D's FACTORY object (SET F1 F2 TO PB451D -> FTAG-D). d)1.b. - `PB389B` holds a PB389D instance (SET B TO D -> DERIVED). d)2.a. - `FACTORY OF PB451B ONLY` holds PB451B's factory exactly (SET FO TO PB451B -> FTAG-B) and refuses a subclass (pb451-classname-sender-only-receiver-subclass). d)2.b. - `PB389B ONLY` holds an instance of exactly that class and refuses a subclass (pb389-only-receiver-subclass-sender). e)1./e)2. - see GR-13.18.60.4-L3.1 / -L3.2. kb/Work PB496 — WAS PARTIAL ('the rule has two limbs and exactly one is live'); CLOSED. Rule: GR22 d)1., `cite.py --check 13.18.60.4 "If the ONLY phrase is not specified"` -> OK 22), with a. `"If the FACTORY phrase is specified, the object referenced by this data item shall be the factory object of the specified class or of a subclass of the specified class"` -> OK 22) and b. `"If the FACTORY phrase is not specified, the object referenced by this data item shall be an instance object of the specified class or of a subclass of the specified class"` -> OK 22). LIMB b) was already CONFORMS in both directions (oo_inherit for the subclass widening; a superclass sender refused by l1-set-sr12a2-superclass-sender). LIMB a) - the one recorded NOT-IMPLEMENTED because `01 O USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE FACTORY OF UBASE.` drew COBOL0899 - is now MEASURED: pb451_set_format5_class_name_sender declares `01 F1 F2 ... FACTORY OF PB451B.` and puts PB451D's FACTORY object in both (SET F1 F2 TO PB451D), and INVOKE F1/F2 "TAG" print FTAG-D, which is 'the factory object of ... a subclass of the specified class' reached through the specified class's description. PB389's golden adds the single-receiver form. The refusing direction of a) is pb451-classname-sender-superclass-name (a SUPERCLASS name into a FACTORY OF subclass receiver), so the limb is pinned both ways and the widening is proved DIRECTIONAL. COBOL0899 (oo-factory-object-reference) is retired in this change set - nothing raises it - so the row's old code-location, the oo-factory-object-reference entry of the rendered diagnostics view, is replaced by the sites that now screen the phrase.

kb/Work PB496 — WAS NOT-IMPLEMENTED ('neither of this row's two subjects parses, so both its limbs and the ACTIVE-CLASS head it carries are unreachable'); CLOSED. Rule: GR22 d)2. ⛔ CITATION CARE - the a./b. sentences of d)2. are STRICT PREFIXES of d)1.'s ('... the factory object of the specified class' vs '... of the specified class or of a subclass of the specified class'), so `cite.py --check` on either body matches the d)1. line; the discriminating fragment is the lead-in `"If the ONLY phrase is specified"` -> OK 22), which returns the `2.` line. DERIVED: with ONLY, the referenced object shall be of THE SPECIFIED CLASS exactly - the factory object of it (a.) or an instance object of it (b.) - i.e. the narrowing of d)1. OBSERVED, both limbs both ways: a. `01 FO ... FACTORY OF PB451B ONLY.` + `SET FO TO PB451B` -> FTAG-B, and the same receiver refuses the SUBCLASS name (pb451-classname-sender-only-receiver-subclass), which is exactly the line the unrestricted twin ACCEPTS (SET F1 F2 TO PB451D -> FTAG-D), so the ONLY axis is proved to be what decides; b. `01 B-ONLY ... PB389B ONLY.` receives INVOKE ... NEW and answers on the OBJECT (-> BASE), and a subclass instance is refused (pb389-only-receiver-subclass-sender). The ONLY phrase is also refused where the general format does not print it - on the interface-name alternative (pb389-interface-name-with-only, COBOL1925). The old evidence (COBOL0307 'unexpected ONLY' for both spellings, and COBOL0813+0901 for the ACTIVE-CLASS head this row also carried) is falsified; the ACTIVE-CLASS head's own witnesses are GR-13.18.60.4-L3.1 / -L3.2 and SR-13.18.60.3-16.

[folded GR-13.18.60.4-L3.1 = §13.18.60.4 22) e) 1.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work PB496 — WAS NOT-IMPLEMENTED ('two independent absences, either of which alone makes the rule unreachable' - the ACTIVE-CLASS phrase did not parse AND the FACTORY limb was loud-staged COBOL0899); CLOSED, both absences repaired by [[PB389]]. Rule: `cite.py --check 13.18.60.4 "If the FACTORY phrase is specified, the object referenced by this data item shall be the factory object of that class"` -> OK 22) (GR22 e)1.), under the e) head `"If ACTIVE-CLASS is specified, the object referenced by this data item shall be of the same class as the object that was used to invoke the method in which this data description entry is specified"` -> OK 22). DERIVED: `USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE FACTORY OF ACTIVE-CLASS` shall bind to the FACTORY OBJECT of the class of the object that INVOKED the enclosing method - which is a runtime fact, not the containing class. OBSERVED: pb496_active_class_positions declares the item in a FACTORY definition's WORKING-STORAGE (an SR16-legal position) and invokes the SAME inherited FMK on PB496C and then on PB496D - the two lines are FTAG-C then FTAG-D, so the item follows the INVOKING class; pb389_object_reference_descriptor's FMK reaches PING-D through an interface view. DISCRIMINATOR: an item bound statically to its containing class prints FTAG-C twice. The refusing arm of the rule's placement obligation (SS14.9.39.3 SR14 b)2.) is pb451-active-class-factory-receiver-in-instance-method. The recorded probe q59 measurement (COBOL0899 + COBOL0901) is falsified: COBOL0899 is retired in this change set and ACTIVE-CLASS is a real token in the FACTORY OF alternative.

[folded GR-13.18.60.4-L3.2 = §13.18.60.4 22) e) 2.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work PB496 — WAS NOT-IMPLEMENTED ('the phrase is not in the grammar and the program is refused with a diagnostic that describes something it did not do'); CLOSED. Rule: `cite.py --check 13.18.60.4 "If the FACTORY phrase is not specified, the object referenced by this data item shall be an instance object of that class"` -> OK 22) (GR22 e)2.), under the e) head validated on L3.1. DISCRIMINATOR: static binding to the containing class prints WHO-C both times. The refusing arm of the placement obligation (SS14.9.39.3 SR14 b)1.) is pb451-active-class-receiver-in-factory-method. The recorded probe q58 measurement (COBOL0813 'names the unknown class or interface ACTIVE-CLASS' + COBOL0901 'is a reserved word') is falsified - both statements were false of the source, and neither diagnostic is raised now.
